name: 62454 · Robinson, IL
findings: ZIP 62454 (Robinson) has 65 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 62454 (Robinson) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 62454 (Robinson) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 54% of all organizations here have no identified type.
